description: Four independent pairs of signals, each pair passed straight through or crossed over depending on whether a reference voltage is above a threshold

params.text: Sets the threshold its own reference input is compared against, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: The voltage compared against the threshold knob for its pair; above the threshold the pair's two signals swap outputs
One of the two signals in its pair; it leaves by the A output while the reference is at or below the threshold, and by the B output while the reference is above it
One of the two signals in its pair; it leaves by the B output while the reference is at or below the threshold, and by the A output while the reference is above it

outputs.text: Carries the A input of its pair while the reference is at or below the threshold, and the B input while the reference is above it
Carries the B input of its pair while the reference is at or below the threshold, and the A input while the reference is above it

notes: an unpatched reference jack reads 0V, so any threshold set below 0V leaves that pair crossed over for good
the comparison is made afresh every sample, with no smoothing, so a reference hovering at the threshold chatters between the two routings
a slip in the source names only one jack in each group, so Rack's own tooltips call every A input A 3, every B input B 3 and every reference Reference 3; the four pairs are in fact independent
